name: Zero Players Online
summary:
Zero Players Online is an interpretation of RuneScape (and Old School RuneScape) as a sort of fancy text-adventure, framed as a long abandoned MUD that nobody has played in a long time.

In the decades since any players joined things have started getting a little strange around Gielinor. NPCs aren't quite acting they way they should, and some areas have changed or become unkempt due to a lack of maintenance.
